title: Honey Soy Chicken
description: Chicken thigh fillets marinated in honey, soy, garlic, and ginger. Pan-fried until sticky and caramelised. Serve with rice and vegetables.

method.instruction: In a bowl, combine honey, soy sauce, garlic, ginger, and oil. Add chicken and mix well to coat.
Cover and marinate in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes, or up to 4 hours.
Heat a large frying pan over medium-high heat. No extra oil needed — the marinade has enough.
Remove chicken from marinade (reserve the marinade). Cook chicken for 4-5 minutes per side until golden, caramelised, and cooked through.
Pour in reserved marinade and simmer for 1-2 minutes until the sauce thickens and coats the chicken.
Serve hot with steamed rice and stir-fried vegetables. Garnish with sliced spring onion and sesame seeds if desired.

notes.title: Marinade Time
notes.content: 30 minutes minimum, 2-4 hours for deeper flavour. Do not marinate overnight — the soy sauce will make the chicken too salty.

notes.title: Thicker Sauce
notes.content: Mix 1 teaspoon cornflour with 2 teaspoons water and add to the sauce in the final minute for a thicker glaze.

notes.title: White Pepper
notes.content: Add ground white pepper to taste if desired — start with a small pinch. White pepper is pungent and a little goes a long way.

notes.title: Garnish
notes.content: Garnish with sliced spring onion and sesame seeds before serving.
